criteria.description: Primary shell and mega disclosure reach every documented state: desktop hover/click open-close with stable corridor and click pin, keyboard Enter/Space, Escape with focus return from summary and from focused destinations, outside/destination/mobile/breakpoint close, same-breakpoint resize stability, mobile activation-only panel
Exactly one primary links tree (#n26-primary-links / ul.ren-nav-links) and one nav landmark serve desktop and mobile — no duplicated responsive branches or nested nav

Exactly one brand, four top entries (3 plain + 1 disclosure), three groups × five title-only destinations (15), one promo CTA, two bar actions, one named toggle, one chevron — no duplicates or invented icon/description destination chrome

Desktop full-width logo-left / links / end actions row; mega full-width absolute under bar with category columns + promo rail; mobile top row logo+toggle only with links and stacked full-width actions below when open; no html overflow at 320/340/390/767/768/769/834/1280
Activating every destination class (category .n26-dest, promo CTA, top-level peers, bar actions) closes the open mega disclosure
Visible 44px targets, axe WCAG 2.1 AA, reduced motion, light/dark token surfaces
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
